integration_decision.name: POST_REPLACE_VS_PRE_REPLACE_BARRIER_ORDERING_ORACLE
integration_decision.source_pinned_observation: runner.run_once performs three separate runner.atomic_write_json calls in latest, audit_latest, anata_latest order. storage.atomic_write_json completes os.replace before returning. The prior sequential two-child test does not overlap writers.
integration_decision.refinement: First boundary: in spawned child A intercept runner.atomic_write_json, call ORIGINAL for latest.json first, then emit A_LATEST_REPLACED ACK and block before audit_latest; parent verifies persisted latest.json matches canonical A golden and A_HISTORY_READ=0 before appending rowB. After B completes all three writes, releasing A must yield B/A/A. Last boundary: allow A to call ORIGINAL for latest and audit, but emit A_ANATA_PRE_REPLACE ACK and block BEFORE calling ORIGINAL for anata_latest; after B completes, releasing A must yield B/B/A. An ACK before latest replacement would instead permit A/A/A and is not a valid first-boundary witness.
integration_decision.runnable_no_network_contract: At fixed T=1700000000000 create isolated A-empty and B-PIT-rowB reference outputs with real run_once(network=False); assert three per-file canonical A!=B and semantic witnesses (latest freshness null vs B non-null, audit visible count 0 vs 1, anata source_evidence empty vs B scoring rowB). Spawn A with child-local wrapper of runner.load_observations: call original once, emit A_HISTORY_READ=0 before rowB append. Install child-local post-replace latest or pre-replace anata barrier as above. Parent must receive both A history and boundary ACKs, then append rowB; B must report 1/1 loaded/scoring, no errors, exit 0, and three persisted B golden matches before A release. After release assert exact B/A/A or B/B/A final vector, both child exitcodes and bounded queue timeouts; run recovery C and returned/persisted scoring/context source_record_id-to-role checks. Then collect-only, targeted and full python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests and retain logs.
integration_decision.claim_boundary: Precise barrier ordering is source-derived and specified only, NOT executed; no production race reproduced.
